compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is part of the WomanLog application setup process, specifically step 4 out of 6. The main content of this screen is an option to enable automatic backup of data to the WomanLog server, which is highly recommended. There is a checkbox to select this option. At the bottom of the screen, there is a "Next" button to proceed to the next step in the setup process. The screen has a simple and clean design with a pink header and footer.
